role: C04 bounded individual contextual source review
decision: This patch adds app-background and elevation-classes as empty mixins in its then-current modern core and invokes them in two upstream applications. The owned facade retains core-theme and legacy-core-theme, and those historical theme files emit background and elevation classes as in the Material 16 reference. Do not insert the empty placeholder mixins into the historical facade. The installed 22.1.7 implementations are now nonempty, a distinct current peer behavior; compiled historical default and custom themes and mixed M2/M3 coexistence remain unverified.

That line is not in the legacy sources. @angular/material/core is exercised by projects/ngx-material-legacy/legacy-menu/menu-module.ts. The commit is an ancestor of v22.1.7 (e950f29dcfbda93c13bff0d1a632465364488249), so installed peer @angular/material@22.1.7 supplies the change.
